Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Two more Mutants are prepared
to stand with our Agents!

 

X-23, who wears the title of the All-New Wolverine,
and Rogue with the power of the strongest Mutants have arrived!

 

Both have become more powerful with not only a new uniform
but also Transcend Potential / Tier-3,
so use these new abilities wisely!

 

[2/23 2:50 a.m. (UTC+0) / 2/22 6:50 p.m. (PST) Added]

The patch has been completed. Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.


■ 2/22 Patch
Patch Schedule: Scheduled to be completed by 2/23 4:00 a.m. (UTC+0) / 2/22 8:00 p.m. (PST)
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the patch application time may vary.
* The game can be played during the patch. 
   We recommend our Agents reconnect to the game to apply the patch once it is available.


▣ 2 New Uniforms Added

 

* New Uniform Skills are based on Skill Level 6 stats.
* The 2 new uniforms will be on sale during the <Rogue & X-23 New Uniforms and Other Uniforms 40% Off!> event after the 2/22 patch and will also be available for purchase in the MARVEL Universe and Uniform Room after the event.

* The new uniforms will be available for purchase after reconnecting to the game and downloading the patch file.
 

 

▣ Rogue Tier-3 Ultimate Skill

 

 

[Rogue Tier-3 Animation]

 


▣ X-23 Transcend Potential & Potential Awakening Added

 

 

[X-23 Potential Awakened Skill Animation]

 

 

▣ Other Information
 

1. When using the Gambit’s <Excalibur> Active 5 Skill ‘Royal Flush’, the -30% decrease of All Defenses (Stacks up to -60%, ignores immunity)(10 Sec.) effect has been changed to stack up faster.
2. The following effect has been added to the Awakened Skill ‘The Full Deck’ of Gambit.
Applies to: Enemies
: -30% decrease of All Defenses (Stacks up to -60%, ignores immunity)(10 Sec.)
* This effect applies from Skill Level 1.

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. The hero's type from the Challenges to unlock World Boss: Legend Difficulty <Knull> Stage 40 has been fixed to match with the requirement to enter Stage 39.
- We have changed the hero requirement to unlock Stage 40 from Star-Lord to Venom.
- We will investigate Agents that have used Crystals to unlock Stage 40 and proceed separate measures.
[Target Challenges]
Agents that have completed Challenges number 7,8, and 9 of Legend Stage 40 through Crystals
[Knull] Clear Legend Stage 39 with STAR-LORD 1/3/5 times
2. The issue where an Agent cannot proceed Story 7-2 stage due to M.O.D.O.K. not being able to enter a warp zone when an Agent has reached the warp zone faster than M.O.D.O.K. has been fixed.
3. The percentage of the last season’s received cheers being displayed as 0% in Timeline Battle has been fixed.
4. The text of Honor Token has been changed to Glory Token at the Daily Trivia.
5. The increase percentage for Acquire Character / Uniform EXP when using a clear ticket from the VIP Bonus has been fixed to clearly display 100%.
 

 

Furthermore, there are various growth events to celebrate
the addition of the new uniforms of Rogue and X-23,
so we look forward to your active participation.

 

Thank you.
